children.name: Roridula dentata L.
children.description: Roridula dentata (also called the northern dewstick) is a protocarnivorous plant native to the Western Cape province of South Africa.

children.name: Roridula gorgonias Planch.
children.description: Roridula gorgonias is an evergreen, branching, upright shrub of up to about 1 m (3 ft) high, from the family Roridulaceae.
